counterline: Use case: product-mockup. Transparent background, isolated precise industrial orbital passenger climber vehicle, the EXTERIOR of a realistic ten-metre-long future pressure vessel built to ascend paired vertical space elevator ribbons. Single object fully in frame upright long axis VERTICAL in a three-quarter front view, gentle camera telephoto, outer pearl-white composite shell in three modules with a thin graphite waist, two raked smoke-black observation windows with visible steel frames, tiny cream lamp pins, narrow oxide-red ID stripe and C12 fleet marking. Exposed carbon guide bogies and small steel roller trucks down its LEFT side, no rockets, no wings or jet engines, no wheels on bottom, hints of orbital thermal blanket and small radiator fins, worn only at guide rollers, mature believable future manufacturing. Photoreal aerospace hardware lit by bright sun from upper left, soft blue Earthshine from lower right, hard highlights against deep graphite panel seams. No ground, shadow plane, backdrop or exterior ribbon, NO display stand. A genuinely transparent isolated photograph for a moving asset.
habitat: Use case: product-mockup. Production 3D texture asset: a TRUE flat orthographic UV unwrap of the exterior skin of a vast O’Neill orbital habitat. The rectangle is the unrolled cylinder: horizontal direction is the full circumference, vertical direction is the axial length. Design THREE broad parallel dark sapphire blue-green GLAZING strips alternating with THREE equally broad light silver/ivory opaque pressure shell strips across the WIDTH. All strips run precisely STRAIGHT VERTICALLY from the bottom edge to the top edge. Seen THROUGH the three glazing strips: fine longitudinal green farm valleys, tiny pale urban settlement blocks, reflective canals under glass, atmosphere in the enclosed habitable world. Surface of glass subdivided by a finely engineered regular lattice of very thin titanium truss ribs and glass cell seams, subtle satin reflections. The three pale opaque strips are covered in truly fine high-resolution manufactured spacecraft paneling, clustered radiator fins, ribbed thermal blankets, inspection patches, micrometeor defense tiles, local service walkways and hardware a few pixels across, fine black panel lines. Scale: 8 km cylinder diameter; the fine details are like orbital photography from a few km away. Neutral physically based base color, flat even diffuse illumination. Texture fills all pixels edge-to-edge, seamless left and right. Cinematic photography realism and precision aerospace engineering, worn and restrained; no text, labels, margins, human, freestanding cylinder, solar wings, sky, perspective or shadows outside panels. Square production map. Only the unwrapped spacecraft outer skin.
